brief:
Three bodies arrived at Shifa Medical Complex on Monday following an Israeli military airstrike on a civilian vehicle in Tel al-Hawa, a neighborhood south of Gaza City, Shehab Wire reported. The strike hit the car in the residential area, according to local sources monitoring the incident.

The deaths mark the latest casualties in the densely populated enclave, where Israeli military operations have continued across multiple neighborhoods and districts. Medical staff at Shifa received the three bodies as rescue and medical personnel worked to respond to the strike in Tel al-Hawa.
